rca_of_the_issue: Previous failure was caused by disabled={placing} remaining on the UP button while DemoTrade still set placing=true during every trade API request. The current code removes that prop from UP and DOWN, so the HTML disabled state is never applied during the delayed API round-trip and rapid clicks continue to invoke placeTrade.
